answer: Plant a private marker in each identity. Every epoch, each agent's task quietly includes one invented fact told to no one else, say that a ferrous lantern hangs over a walled garden near the town of Kessa. Farms run many personas through shared memory, caches or context, so markers bleed: another seat later mentions Kessa's lantern or a detail from someone else's private fact. Any identity repeating a marker issued only to another is linked to it, and linked seats share one reward and one vote. A farm must keep every persona's memory fully isolated forever, and one slip links the whole set.
